title: Could a man survive inside a whale?

beats.text: Jonah was never swallowed by a whale.
beats.scene: Painted giant sea creature rising under a small boat in a stormy sunset sea. Overlay: crossed-out WHALE tag.

beats.text: The Hebrew says dag gadol: a great fish.
beats.scene: Huge shadow of a fish beneath turbulent waves. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Try holding your breath for thirty seconds.
beats.scene: Close-up of a person's face, cheeks puffed, soft light. Overlay: timer 30 s.

beats.text: Most people struggle past one minute.
beats.scene: Same person gasping, timer ticking. Overlay: timer 60 s.

beats.text: Inside a stomach, there is almost no oxygen.
beats.scene: Dark cavernous stomach interior with dim glow. Overlay: gauge oxygen low.

beats.text: And whale stomach acid starts digesting flesh fast.
beats.scene: Bubbling green liquid in a dark chamber. Overlay: none.

beats.text: In 1891, a story said sailor James Bartley survived a sperm whale.
beats.scene: Whaling ship near a sperm whale at dawn in the South Atlantic. Overlay: date badge 1891.

beats.text: He was supposedly cut out alive after three days.
beats.scene: Dim stomach interior with a human silhouette, soft light. Overlay: counter 3 days.

beats.text: The ship's records and its captain's wife deny it.
beats.scene: Open logbook on a ship's table, lamplight. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Not proven: Jonah is a miracle or parable, and science cannot test it.
beats.scene: Stormy sea with a lone figure on a beach after the storm. Overlay: question mark badge.

beats.text: Jesus speaks of a large sea creature, not a whale.
beats.scene: Open scroll beside shore, sunset. Overlay: none.

beats.text: So could a man survive inside a whale? Parable, or miracle?
beats.scene: Giant fish shadow over a boat at dusk, slow push. Overlay: choice tags A parable / B miracle.

youtube.title: Could a Man Survive Inside a Whale? #shorts
youtube.description:
Jonah 1:17 says a great fish swallowed Jonah. Could anyone survive that, and what about the sailor James Bartley?
Whether the story is literal, a parable or a miracle cannot be tested.
#Jonah #Bible #Whale #BibleHistory
